paper.title_en: Analytical Estimates of Gravitational Wave Background Anisotropies from Shot Noise and Large-Scale Structure in Pulsar Timing Arrays
paper.abstract_en: An important next step for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) is to measure anisotropies in the gravitational wave background (GWB) at $\sim$ nano-Hz frequencies. We calculate the expected GWB anisotropies using empirically calibrated models for the merger rates of supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs). The anisotropies reflect both shot-noise in the discrete SMBHB populations while also tracing, in part, the large-scale structure (LSS) of the universe. The shot-noise term is sensitive to the high-mass end of the merging SMBH mass function, depends somewhat on the low-redshift tail of the merger distribution, and is a strong function of observing frequency. The precise frequency dependence provides a test of SMBHB residence times. In our models, the mean shot-noise anisotropy typically lies close to or above the broad frequency-band NANOGrav upper limits. Consequently, near-future PTA data, and potentially re-analyses of existing measurements using frequency-dependent shot-noise anisotropy templates, should be capable of detecting this signal or placing meaningful constraints on SMBHB merger models. A full interpretation, however, will require modeling the probability distribution of shot-noise amplitudes rather than relying solely on ensemble-averaged predictions. The LSS-induced anisotropies are at least two to three orders of magnitude smaller. Although the LSS contribution contains valuable information regarding the redshift distribution and clustering bias of the merging SMBHBs, detecting this component will be challenging.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文聚焦于脉冲星计时阵列中引力波背景各向异性的解析估计，属于PTA领域的核心研究主题，理论深度较高，方法严谨，具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中来自散粒噪声和大尺度结构的引力波背景各向异性的解析估计
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）的一个重要下一步是测量频率约为纳赫兹的引力波背景（GWB）的各向异性。我们使用经验校准的超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHBs）并合率模型来计算预期的GWB各向异性。这些各向异性既反映了离散SMBHB种群中的散粒噪声，也在一定程度上追踪了宇宙的大尺度结构（LSS）。散粒噪声项对并合SMBH质量函数的高质量端敏感，一定程度上依赖于并合分布的低红移尾部，并且是观测频率的强函数。精确的频率依赖性为SMBHB停留时间提供了检验。在我们的模型中，平均散粒噪声各向异性通常接近或高于宽频带NANOGrav上限。因此，近期的PTA数据，以及可能利用依赖于频率的散粒噪声各向异性模板对现有测量的重新分析，应该能够探测到这一信号或对SMBHB并合模型施加有意义的约束。然而，完整的解释需要模拟散粒噪声振幅的概率分布，而不是仅依赖系综平均的预测。LSS引起的各向异性至少小两到三个数量级。尽管LSS贡献包含有关并合SMBHB的红移分布和成团偏置的有价值信息，但探测这一组成部分将具有挑战性。
